name: Piskel
tagline: A pixel and sprite editor. Animated GIF out, nothing uploaded.
description:
Draw sprites and pixel art, frame by frame, with a ghost of the last frame as you go. Pen, eraser, fill, stroke, rectangle, circle, lighten, dither, and the selection tools. Layers, a palette, transform, resize. When the walk cycle is done, export it as an animated GIF — or PNG, a sprite sheet, a ZIP of frames, or a .piskel file you can open again later.

The sprite auto-saves on this device, inside the app. Close it, open it later, the frames are where you left them. There is no account and no piskelapp.com: Save in Browser stays here, Save as .piskel downloads a file, and Export never leaves this tab.

An unofficial port of Piskel by Julian Descottes, Apache-2.0. Piskelapp did not endorse this listing. This copy keeps the editor and the exporters, and drops the gallery, the login, and every path that talked to their servers.
